code/rust/core_contracts/src/witness.rs: BasisCard admits positive, matching dimension/vector-count metadata from public vector-space and independence witnesses when class/certainty and supplied verification booleans agree. It does not receive basis vectors, recompute rank or operations, validate hash grammar, or bind a contract schema. Public witness constructors/fields can assert StructuralProof without those computations. Tests construct metadata, including a short arbitrary basis hash, and cover zero/mismatched dimensions and counts. The result is declared-metadata agreement, not an independently checked linear-independence certificate.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/witness_cap: HasPhi supplies unvalidated f64; the law helper tests <= and subtracts values, allowing negative Phi and infinity-to-infinity monotonicity with NaN delta. Generic PartialOrd relations are caller-defined measurements. ExactObstruction instead privately stores u64 before/after and checked nonnegative drop, including zero. Its two meaningful tests cover decrease and refusal of increase. Numerical commentary is not a general exact obstruction proof.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/witness_wit: ForbiddenCapabilityWitness checks a static ten-enum-member capability list against the named expected ten using membership, duplicate refusal and checked counts. Its test checks exactly ten. This verifies configuration-list consistency; it does not establish that runtime code cannot exercise those capabilities.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/traits.rs: Reexports twelve trait layers. LayerPermutation checks length twelve, images in range, uniqueness and inversion parity, retaining only sign. The transposition test exercises parity; its repeated-index test supplies length two and therefore fails the length gate before duplicate detection. This finite permutation calculation does not prove the architecture's trait composition laws.
Reexports validation modules. InvariantCoverage accepts exactly when supplied u32 satisfied and declared counts agree, including zero/zero, and uses checked subtraction. Tests cover 4/4 and 4/3. No predicate identity census or predicate evaluation is received, so equality of counts does not independently establish that each invariant was checked.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/runtime.rs: RuntimeBudget is an immutable checked-u64 arithmetic model of limit/spent/remaining; spending zero and a zero limit are allowed. Tests cover remaining budget and overspend, alongside the exactly reconstructed shared capacity template. This models a caller's declared costs, not persistent or concurrent billing or measured execution cost.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/witness_evi: Defines declarative witness classes and ordered certainty labels plus publicly implementable TraitValidationWitness with an overridable EvidenceOnly default. Verification result fields/setters allow blank or unspecified bindings. Public Phi/idempotence/determinism, replay, hash, vector-space and independence structs expose supplied booleans/hashes; several hardcode StructuralProof without performing the represented computations. Tests check labels/defaults and capability-list entries, plus shared capacity boilerplate. These objects do not themselves authorize promotion; consumers must validate the underlying claims.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/witness_law: Generic and erased law checkers execute caller implementations and report success/failure with evidence-only authority. The framed BLAKE3 report identifier includes law/checker/schema/category/severity/status metadata but check_all_laws always supplies no subject hash and excludes witness/violation bytes; distinct subjects/evidence with matching metadata/status share an identifier. Hard-law aggregation intentionally ignores warnings/soft failures and accepts an empty report list. Local test checkers are toy examples: supplied scalar norm tolerance, supplied hashes or booleans, and metadata classifications, not production matrix proofs. Tests cover dispatch and severity aggregation but not subject/evidence binding. No report consumer beyond the inspected test owners was found in the targeted source search.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/functional_: The production marker is an empty property-witness container. Test-only code exercises one exact scalar Phi1 primal/dual repair and one closed-residual outcome through external owners; it does not establish all trichotomy branches or the general theorem. A YAML binding test compares contract URN and dependency set membership, not multiplicity, schema digests or laws. The shared capacity template is exactly reconstructed. These tests were read, not rerun in this phase.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/contract_pr: Defines a marker BoundaryError alias and a test that a type name exists. ClassificationCensus counts the five declared E/I/C/R/M enum classes with checked u32 addition and requires total equal to input length; empty input is allowed. Its one-each test checks counting, not semantics of operators assigned these labels. Shared capacity code contributes only a positive count/capacity boundary.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/contract_im: Includes the build-generated contract image source and correctly documents images as declarations rather than implementations or law proofs. ContractImageCensus rejects empty ID/type and duplicate IDs, then partitions supplied statuses into canonical/staged admitted versus archived/deprecated refused using checked i64 counts. Tests cover all statuses, blanks/duplicates and generated-catalog nonemptiness. Status-based admission is metadata classification, not authority or verified implementation. The included generated owner's build dependencies remain separately reviewable.
